Title: Passenger Service
Description: Delivered frontline passenger service support by assisting travellers with check-in procedures, boarding enquiries, and wayfinding in a fast-paced aviation environment at SATS Ltd.. - Developed strong communication and operational coordination skills through interactions with passengers, airline personnel, and ground operations teams. - Applied problem-solving and adaptability when managing passenger concerns, flight disruptions, and time-sensitive situations while maintaining professionalism under pressure. - Gained exposure to airport operations, aviation safety procedures, and the importance of efficiency and precision within the aerospace and aviation industry. - Collaborated effectively with multidisciplinary teams to support smooth passenger flow, operational efficiency, and a positive travel experience.

Title: Customer Service Ambassador
Description: - Delivered frontline customer service support by assisting patients and visitors with enquiries, directions, and appointment-related matters in a fast-paced healthcare environment. - Demonstrated strong communication and interpersonal skills when interacting with patients from diverse backgrounds while maintaining professionalism and empathy. - Applied problem-solving skills to address customer concerns efficiently and escalate issues appropriately to ensure smooth service delivery. - Adapted effectively under pressure by managing multiple responsibilities simultaneously while maintaining composure and service excellence. - Collaborated closely with healthcare staff and fellow ambassadors to create a positive, supportive, and patient-focused environment.
